verdict.rationale: Codex is fundamentally an AI coding agent designed to have tasks delegated to it—via CLI, IDE extension, desktop app, or cloud—covering exploring code, editing files, running commands, and returning results for review (codex-docs-6, codex-docs-9, codex-docs-15, codex-gh-1). Community evidence confirms real-world delegation usage, with some praising it as equivalent to a junior engineer and others noting slowness/rate-limit friction, but the core delegate-and-return workflow is well substantiated.
